title: pp.fft-stretch~
description: `pp.fft-stretch~` is a stereo phase-vocoder abstraction for time-stretching buffered or recorded audio, with independent playback-speed and transposition controls. It accepts signal-rate speed and transposition inputs as well as control messages for playback, position, looping, freezing, FFT settings, and Paulstretch-like phase randomization; its creation arguments set FFT block size and overlap, defaulting to 1024 and 4.
